issues.issue: Whether the IJ affidavit, sworn after the RPD decision, is admitted as new evidence
issues.applicant_position: Submits IJ's affidavit correcting a misspelling in his letter; the spelling error may be typographical.
issues.result_text: Affidavit not admitted: no admissibility submissions, and the information could have been given before the RPD decision.

issues.issue: Whether the police invitation letter and arrest warrant are new, credible evidence of persecution
issues.applicant_position: Submits a 2018 police invitation letter and warrant as new evidence of the threat.
issues.result_text: Documents have many discrepancies and no reliable receipt evidence; treated as likely fraudulent and not admitted.

issues.issue: Whether an oral hearing should be held
issues.result_text: No new evidence admitted, so the RAD has no jurisdiction to hold an oral hearing.

issues.issue: Whether SA's testimony about the arrest warrant and IJ's knowledge is reliable
issues.applicant_position: SA explained neighbour IJ was questioned and the pastor saw the police warrant; RPD erred.
issues.result_text: SA was evasive; IJ's letter is unreliable; no arrest warrant issued on a balance of probabilities.

issues.issue: Whether former counsel's inadequate representation explains the omissions
issues.applicant_position: Appellants relied on previous counsel for narrative and forms; RPD conclusions are in error.
issues.result_text: IRB Practice Notice steps were not followed, so the inadequate-representation allegations fail.

issues.issue: Whether the Third Appellant's bisexuality is established and his omissions explained
issues.applicant_position: TA felt uncomfortable describing same-sex relationships before family at the hearing.
issues.result_text: RPD made no error; TA was asked and said it was fine; sexual orientation not established on balance.
